W.note: Only build with true polygon (SAT) collisions and rotation, so the drag pile tumbles believably, but it offers only a Reset button and no instructions, and the floor is invisible at rest.

X.note: Clean toolbar with Add, Reset, Clear and a live count plus a hint, and direct drag with throw, though boxes are axis-aligned only and the bottom hint overlaps boxes on phone.

Y.note: Most polished: a floating control panel with Add, Gravity toggle, Reset and Clear, a status HUD, 8 substeps, spring drag with throw, and a steady stack; the HUD slightly overlaps boxes on phone.

Z.note: Most literal drag (kinematic follow with throw on release) and a clear floor, but axis-aligned boxes, only a Reset button, no on-screen instructions, and adding boxes only works via an undiscoverable click on empty space.
